changesAfterFirstRun: Coverage now counts query terms that appear nowhere in the corpus (previously ignored), so questions about things the reports never mention are not treated as covered.
Calculation stage only answers when every content word is the metric, a company or a year; before, 'net sales in the Novartis oncology area' returned total revenue.
Revenue growth is computed in each company's reporting currency; before, GSK growth was shown in USD and included exchange-rate movement (7.4% instead of 4.1%).
Forecast guard now catches 'will ... be' (before, only the adjacent words 'will be').
Company names are removed from the scored query (they select the filing; they are not evidence).
Stemmer extended (past tense, -ation/-ion, silent e) and question words (many, much, ...) added to the stop list.
Retrieval refuses when the query's rarest term is absent from the top passage (stops lexically adjacent but unrelated passages being shown as answers).
notes: Development set: used while building the system, so its final numbers are optimistic. The 'firstRun' block is the result before any change. Held-out results are in eval-heldout-results.json.
